courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 聯邦大橋（加拿大）
related.transfer: 可遷移「浮吊工法的系統與吊索傳力」與「吊重與重心的量測驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；聯邦大橋（加拿大）的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "System logic and sling load path" and "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Confederation Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以吊索幾何、動態放大、浮體穩定與天候窗口控制，把千噸級預製橋段從駁船安全吊上橋墩；聯邦大橋（加拿大）則以以冰盾錐體、超大型預製構件與百年耐久設計，跨越冬季浮冰的諾森伯蘭海峽為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sling geometry, dynamic amplification, floating stability and weather windows that bring thousand-tonne prefabricated segments safely from barge to pier; Confederation Bridge centres on crossing the ice-covered Northumberland Strait with ice-shield cones, very large precast components and a 100-year durability design, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「吊索與吊梁」與「冰盾錐體」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到聯邦大橋（加拿大），標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「冰力與結構反應監測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Slings and spreader beam” and “Ice-shield cone”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Confederation Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Monitoring ice forces and response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 浮吊大型橋段吊裝
history.titleEn: Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments
history.text: 大型浮吊讓跨海橋梁可以把整段構件在岸上預製再一次吊放。荷蘭建造的雙體重吊船 Svanen 原為丹麥大貝爾特橋建造，之後在 1994 至 1996 年為加拿大聯邦大橋吊放墩座、主梁與落入跨等大型預製構件，這座長 12.9 km、主跨 250 m 的橋於 1997 年 5 月 31 日通車，之後 Svanen 又參與厄勒海峽大橋。2009 年建成的剪腿式浮吊 Left Coast Lifter 額定約 1,700 t，在 2010 至 2011 年為舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段吊放 28 段箱梁橋面，2014 年改名 I Lift NY，在 2015 至 2018 年參與紐約新 Tappan Zee 橋（州長 Mario M. Cuomo 橋）的建造，之後並協助拆除舊橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Large floating cranes let sea crossings prefabricate whole members on shore and set them in one lift. The Dutch-built catamaran heavy-lift vessel Svanen, originally built for Denmark's Great Belt crossing, placed pier bases, main girders and drop-in spans for Canada's Confederation Bridge between 1994 and 1996; the 12.9 km bridge with 250 m main spans opened on 31 May 1997, and Svanen went on to the Øresund Bridge. The shear-leg crane barge Left Coast Lifter, built in 2009 and rated about 1,700 t, placed 28 box-girder deck sections for the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge east span in 2010–2011, then as I Lift NY helped build New York's new Tappan Zee crossing, the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge, between 2015 and 2018 and afterwards helped dismantle the old bridge. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
